name: Dragons Xmas Dig
description:
We have acres and acres of land to go at this brand new farm located in the historic town of Much Marcle.
On the old maps and such, we are detecting on the farm that belonged directly to the old castle, which was a manor.
Recce was productive with lots of targets and no green waste. The more we get on here, the more we'll open up; simple as that!
Usual stuff. £20 per-person, spade carriers and U16s are free. NCMD insurance or equivalent is required. Unfortunately, no dogs allowed due to livestock. Treasure acts to be followed and tidy hole filling at all times.
